method: 8-neighbor A* on pinned 70.211 m USGS 3DEP raster; exclude NHD water polygons buffered 140m, edge slope ceiling 2.5%; cost distance*(1+1800*grade^2); resample300m, cubic spline s=N*100^2 with endpoint weights1e6; sample plan40m and ground approximately70m; separate constrained L1 formation profile
